column1: # precommit/gate.sh runs the full suite on every commit. A failing test that
# is listed here is expected (TDD: red test first, implementation lands in a
# later commit of the same PR) and does NOT block the commit; the failure is
# still logged. Remove the row as soon as the implementation turns the test
# green — an unlisted failure blocks the commit.
# Rows are matched on the <test-name> printed by the suite (e.g. `bench`,
# TDD-red: s5-ctx-x86 x86-64 SysV backend lane (issue #72), implemented in
# a later commit of this PR. The gate matches the aggregate `make test-s5`
# run_check name (`s5-tests`); removed once the backend turns the lane green.
